narrative: GET /batches/:id/status exposes moduleStates and document queue for live UI.
Platform module serves pipeline guide and module registry for PipelineModuleRail.
Batch package zip via POST/GET .../package routes.
file-exchange/clear API and npm run clear:file-exchange for dated import/export cleanup.
Gitignore hardened for runtime file-exchange payloads; golden v002 fixtures committed.

decisions.decision: Async process-batch with polling instead of blocking 201 for default UX
decisions.rationale: Live pipeline rail and document queue require incremental status while documents process.
decisions.tradeoff: Clients must poll; simpler than WS for local dev.

decisions.decision: Platform routes use platform.service for module registry (layer lint)
decisions.rationale: routes layer must not import domain per MODULE_INTERNAL_CONTRACT.
alternativesRejected: Disable layer rule for platform routes
decisions.tradeoff: Thin service wrapper over static registry.

iterations.action: Committed 007 WIP in three feature commits after fixing platform layer lint and gitignore
Added batch-async.routes.test.js and docs/platform/API.md for lint:api-docs

tradeoffs: Background batch uses setImmediate in-process; not durable across server restart.
Runtime file-exchange imports still on disk locally but gitignored.
improvements: Pipeline UI with module rail, document queue, batch persistence in URL/localStorage.
Onboarding page and API for pipeline guide.
Rule authority v002 golden dataset and compareGoldenRuleFields eval support.
regressions: None known; sync path preserved via CASE_FILING_SYNC_BATCH=true for integration tests.
risks: Accidental commit of large PDFs if gitignore rules are bypassed with force-add.
Long batches without compact snapshot rules may hit token limits when using v001 prompt.
followUps: External artifact root (local-artifacts.json) after PR merge.
Merge v001 master prompt with compact snapshot bounding.
Optional: durable job queue for async batch beyond setImmediate.
